data.one_liner: Widget that reports visibility changes of its child
data.what_it_does: Wraps a child widget and notifies a callback when its visibility changes. The callback receives a VisibilityInfo with the visible fraction.
use_when: Trigger lazy loading or animations when a widget becomes visible
Detect when a widget is scrolled off screen
avoid_when: When visibility must account for opacity or overlapping widgets
When precise pixel-level visibility is required
weaknesses: Visible fraction may be inaccurate if obscured by other widgets
